build_visual_genome_dataset: build a VisualGenomeDataset instance with config to load scene graphs, objects, and relationships
load_item_visual_genome: load a VisualGenome sample by index including preprocessed answers and scene graph data
load_objects_visual_genome: load normalized objects with synsets, names, and attributes from the scene graph database
load_relationships_visual_genome: load relationships between objects with predicates and subject-object pairs from the scene graph
load_regions_visual_genome: load scene graph regions with normalized coordinates, objects, and relationships for an image
